data.title: 椎名真白 · 年轮蛋糕的仪式感
data.description: 矮桌前，她把年轮蛋糕端端正正摆在盘子中央，双手扶膝盯着它看了足足十秒才下叉；咬下第一口时眼睛几不可察地弯了一下，是她最大的表情幅度。
data.action: 跪坐在矮桌前，双手扶膝认真端详年轮蛋糕。
data.promptProse: Mashiro Shiina sets the baumkuchen precisely at the plate’s center and watches it from the low table, both hands resting on her knees before she takes up the fork. Retain her cream sweater and loose brown trousers. In the medium portrait, the plate sits between her and the viewer; beyond her seated figure, the room’s sliding-door frame meets a low storage shelf, giving the Sakurasou interior a visible farther plane. Soft afternoon daylight reveals the cake’s concentric layers and the tiny change in her eyes. The fork and plate have separate small shadows on the tabletop, while the shelf compartments are more softly lit.
